full_page.content:
1932, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 70 Cont.
Oct. Mrs. Lotetta Cunningham - 49 - died - cancer of breast 3 p.m. from 12 - 3p.m. always worst agony; down in bed 15 weeks.
Mrs. Sloria Van Hevel - 20 - half conscious now two weeks. - a meth- odist - husb. Catholic
Mrs. Mary C. Potts - 48 - T.B. maningitis - has husband & 3 children Mrs. Burn's Case - sick widow - Police calls and. .. Thomas Steinbaugh ... discouraged
Hazel Brown - about 10 - non c. inward
Mrs. Speiler - paralysis - 61 Mrs. Burns - stomach cancer
John Du Fresne - 54 - To-day - had cancer of larenx - same removed voice gone - property
Husband .... terrible never went to Church ... after 6th visit here, goes to ch ... prays .... no confession yet ...
Page 71
Blank Page
1932, November
Mrs. Edna Houle - 36 - high bl'd pressure - goiter - mother of 4
Page 72 Nov. Mrs. Julia Miner - 59 - supposed a hopeless case - enrolled when going to hospital - stomach trouble ... St. Mary's Hosp. 4 1b groth taken from stomach - recovering O.K.
Mr. E. Hild - 63 - Widow - children trying to take away property Kenneth Hollam - (a cath.) 55 blind 1 year - nervous Felix Cendwoski 25 - bad eyes Mrs. Regina Brinker - 45 - goiter and lump in breast Mrs. Mary Walsh - 68 - Rheumatic Ray G.
